description.value: Matsqui Centennial Auditorium is a civic performing arts venue in Abbotsford operated by the City of Abbotsford Parks, Recreation & Culture, opened in November 1992. It serves as a community gathering space for concerts, theatre productions, and public events in the Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists passing through Abbotsford may find it a cultural stop in the heart of the city.
